title: Oscilloscope
excerpt: Update for the Scope module originally made by Mark Harris : there was a bug...
content:
Update for the Scope module originally made by Mark Harris : 

there was a bug that caused some graphics/messages to stop appearing from other modules (like the "empty" one), i managed to fix it and add features :

knob1 → framerate* (10-25fps)
knob2 → zoom (1-13x)
knob3 → freeze (at max position)
aux → screenshot (into /usbdrive)

* affects the zoom to show a longer waveform when decreasing the framerate

It also now analyzes L+R instead of L only.

#1 : copy oscilloscope_1-5.zop to /Patches
#2 : reload the Organelle (menu Storage -> Reload)
#3 : run “Install oscilloscope_1-5.zop”

v1.5 now renamed and installed into /media/orac/usermodules/utility to automatically replace the original scope module without overwriting it, also somehow there was a massive issue i didn't notice with the gain (knob3) so i removed it

v1.4 : UI bugfixes

Install/Unzip the way you want. ✌︎

made on Organelle M (OS 3.2) for Orac 2.0
